The '''Naval Subcommittee''' was the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] commission that oversaw the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. [[Senator/Legends|Senators]] [[Gopple]] and [[V'troren Tara]] sat on it near the end of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of its branches was the [[Procurement Panel/Legends|Procurement Panel]].<ref name="ISB" />
